checks.message: Manufacturer drawing review remains open for DRV8353 RTA; J4 requires FLUX harness verification; D2 and D3-D5 package numbering require independent verification. See data provisionalReason fields.

Motor OD112 and six Ø4.5 holes on PCD104 are sourced from the motor study. The Ø28 PCB opening is proposed from the shoulder opening; axial clearance, standoffs, encoder mount and assembly fit remain unverified.
Kelvin routing, gate loops, decoupler placement, creepage, current paths, and thermal interfaces require PCB/layout review.
Voltage/pulse/current/temperature ratings, capacitor bias/ripple derating, fuse coordination, TVS clamping, and MOSFET SOA require selected-part evidence and bench tests.
Threshold calculations are nominal (3.3 V, 2.5 V, CSA gain 20); worst-case reference/comparator/CSA/resistor tolerances and fault response time remain unverified.
External 4.7-ohm / 200-W resistor energy, cooling, wiring inductance, duty cycle, and thermal cutoff remain system-level open items.
MCU alternate functions, CSA register settings, dead time, ADC timing, BiSS framing, watchdog service, and no automatic rearm require firmware and hardware validation.
FLUX order code, connector orientation, 12-V startup current, remote clock termination, and mechanical fit require supplier/harness confirmation.
